data.description: 【泥岩 · 训练场】重装干员演练场中央，拄着巨锤傲然伫立的泥岩周围环绕着坚不可摧的沃土石巨人守卫。演练结束后她收起土石魔术，神情气定神闲地向你行礼——「萨卡兹的古老巫术与泥土共鸣，只要双脚踏在这片大地上，我就绝不会退后半步。」
data.promptProse: Mudrock stands calmly beside her planted enormous warhammer after the exercise, black high-neck bodysuit and remaining pauldrons and gauntlets distinct beneath loose silver-white hair and Sarkaz horns. Earth-and-stone guardian golems encircle the drill ground farther back. The low view connects hammer base to the completed training area. Cool morning light catches armor and rough golem edges, casting broad stone shadows across the ground while preserving her relaxed, steady posture.
data.title: 泥岩 · 训练场
